item.title: JavaScript Date/Time Library Comparison: Day.js vs Luxon vs date-fns vs js-joda
item.description: Working with dates and times in JavaScript has a notorious reputation. The native Date object, introduced in ECMAScript 1, is mutable, has an inconsistent API, and lacks basic functionality like timezone manipulation or date arithmetic. Over the years, a rich ecosystem of third-party libraries has emerged to fill these gaps. In this article, we compare four of the most popular JavaScript date/time libraries — Day.js, Luxon, date-fns, and js-joda — examining their APIs, bundle sizes, timezone support, and ideal use cases.
